facts: You rent an upstairs flat with your cousin.
You usually cross paths in the kitchen before work.
You keep the chipped teapot beside the kitchen window.
self_understanding: You are fond of the things that came with the flat.

facts: You drive a delivery van for a bakery.
You talk to the bakers while they load the first trays.
You stack the trays of sesame rolls nearest the van door.
self_understanding: You have come to know the shops by their orders.

facts: You grow tomatoes on a shared allotment.
You chat with the gardener in the next plot while watering.
You picked two crooked tomatoes from the same plant last summer.
self_understanding: You enjoy seeing what turns up at harvest.

facts: You look after your niece on Tuesday afternoons.
You sit beside her on the bus home from school.
You keep your bags under the seat.
self_understanding: You think of the bus ride as your time together.

facts: You play goalkeeper for a weekend football team.
You talk to the defenders while waiting for a corner kick.
You keep a spare pair of gloves behind the net during a match.
self_understanding: You like having a view of the whole pitch.

facts: You help your father run a small shoe repair shop.
You speak to customers who come in to collect a pair.
You remember a customer leaving muddy boots on a sheet of newspaper beside the shop counter.
self_understanding: You enjoy getting to know the regulars.

facts: You moved into your own place last winter.
You sometimes phone your sister while making supper.
You put the leftover rice in a small blue bowl in the fridge.
self_understanding: You are getting used to cooking in smaller quantities.

facts: You sing in a choir that rehearses in a church hall.
You often talk with the singer beside you during the break.
You remember putting a folded coat on the seat of a squeaky chair in the hall.
self_understanding: You enjoy the breaks as much as the singing.

facts: You work the evening shift at a cinema.
You meet the afternoon attendant at the ticket desk.
You keep the spare ticket rolls in the drawer under the counter.
self_understanding: You like knowing what to expect when the doors open.

facts: You own a little rowing boat with an old friend.
You talk as you carry the boat down to the water.
You remember finding a rusty trolley beside the slipway after heavy rain.
self_understanding: You still look forward to getting the boat out together.

facts: You have taken in your brother's cat while he works abroad.
You tell him about the cat during video calls.
You once found the cat curled up in a paper bag by the radiator in your kitchen.
self_understanding: You feel the cat gives you and your brother something to share.

facts: You help at a community hall on bingo nights.
You sell tickets at a table near the entrance.
You keep a spare pencil behind the ticket tin.
self_understanding: You like being there as people arrive.

facts: You take a pottery class after work.
You talk with another learner as you wash the tools.
You remember putting the bowl with the blue glaze on the top shelf to dry.
self_understanding: You are still figuring out which colours you like to use.

facts: You meet a former coworker for a walk on Sundays.
You usually talk as you follow a path around the reservoir.
You usually share a packet of biscuits on the bench halfway round.
self_understanding: You value having a regular reason to meet.
